pages.title: Store by the Rules
pages.text: Verify the rule through real transfers; a spare filter and connectors support a separate network branch.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Multi-item filters compare type/damage/data, tag filters match groups, polymorphic accepts existing types. Priority chooses storage and keep-last retains an exemplar; Inventory Hopper imports/exports.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use an Inventory Hopper, set its filter with an item and clear it with empty-hand sneak interaction. Import or export selected items to the network.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Configure a multi-item filter for damage/NBT, a tag filter, or a polymorphic filter that accepts types already present. Select allow/reject behavior and inventory priorities; keep-last preserves a slot exemplar.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Storage Filter constrains this container insertion/extraction; it does not automatically inherit the separate terminal-network filter.
